title: 7 Small Compromises a Godly Man Refuses to Call Harmless
caption:
Nothing that's actually killing you introduced itself that way. It always shows up small and calls itself harmless.

The white lie to keep the peace. The lingering look you call "just noticing." The rounded-up number on the expense report. The "just this once" scroll at 1 a.m. The joke that costs somebody else. The debt you hide from the one person who could help. The grudge dressed up as honesty.

Scripture doesn't say manage your sin. It says put it to death, and it never gets to skip the small ones.
